storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS F34ZJK R222 - Progressive vision: the planning of downtown Cleveland, 1903-1930
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: Andy Chakalis is listed among the creators of a 1986 exhibition catalog tied to the same planning exhibition named in his biography. Request cover, title, credit pages, and an illustrated planning spread before display selection.
storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Direct work/publication lead for exhibition display.
storySectionReviewDrafts.copyrightNote: Catalog metadata only; item inspection, page selection, credit role, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS Pam. Z1997 - Trideset: Cleveland, Ohio, November 1991
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: The WRHS catalog indexes Tony Petkovsek as a subject of a 1991 Thanksgiving polka party program. Request the cover and selected event spread while preserving the documented 1991 Tower City hotel venue.
storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Direct event-program lead for music, radio, travel, and community gathering interpretation.
storySectionReviewDrafts.copyrightNote: Catalog metadata only; performers, interior contents, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS NA737 F596A4 Oversize - Richard Fleischman: spaces to be shared
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: WRHS holds the illustrated 1996 volume Richard Fleischman: spaces to be shared. Request candidate architectural spreads and credit pages; do not label the volume solely authored by Fleischman without checking the creator credits.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS F34ZJK R511D75 Oversize - Downtown Cleveland development handbook
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: The 1983 Downtown Cleveland development handbook lists Richard Fleischman Architects, Inc. among creators and includes illustrated color plans. It can also provide municipal context for George Voinovich as mayor, without implying authorship of individual plans.
storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Direct firm/publication lead and contextual municipal-planning lead.
storySectionReviewDrafts.copyrightNote: Catalog metadata only; selected plans, built/unbuilt status, attribution, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS F34ZYE S955 1988 - Warehouse District building conditions survey
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: The 1988 Warehouse District building-conditions survey lists Richard Fleischman Architects, Inc. as a creator and includes plans. It may provide neighborhood preservation context for Jack Coyne, but Coyne participation is not established.
storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Direct firm/publication lead and contextual preservation lead.
storySectionReviewDrafts.copyrightNote: Catalog metadata only; individual building page, Coyne connection, attribution, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS MS4899 - John P. Kilroy Papers, Padraic Pearce/Pearse Center organizational documents
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: MS4899 box 1 folders 13-14 include Padraic Pearce/Pearse Center organizational documents, library proposals, grants, and minutes from 1985-1987. Request signatures and minute entries before upgrading any document to a personal McCauley connection.
storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Close institutional lead for founding-period Irish community memory work.
storySectionReviewDrafts.copyrightNote: Finding-aid metadata only; authorship, signatures, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS MS4174 - Slovenian National Home Records, common stock certificates
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: MS4174 box 1 folder 5 includes common stock certificates from about 1920 for the Slovenian National Home. Use only as earlier venue/context material beside Petkovsek's 1991 program, not as his personal document.
storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Contextual venue-history lead paired with a direct Petkovsek event program.
storySectionReviewDrafts.copyrightNote: Finding-aid metadata only; certificate text, issuer, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS PG594 - Greater Cleveland Ethnographic Museum Photographs, Croatian costume and exhibit folders
storySectionReviewDrafts.excerpt: PG594 lists Croatian national costume and Croatian exhibit photograph folders. These contextual images relate to cultural practice, but no photograph is verified as depicting Branka Malinar, her costume, or her museum.
storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Contextual image lead for Croatian folk-dance and heritage interpretation.
storySectionReviewDrafts.copyrightNote: Finding-aid metadata only; image subjects, captions, loan, and reproduction permissions remain unchecked.

storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Contextual event lead requiring participant and image identification review.

storySectionReviewDrafts.sourcePageTitle: WRHS PG527 - Mitchell McLaughlin at Cleveland City Club, 1994

storySectionReviewDrafts.candidateUse: Contextual forum lead only; do not identify Foster in the image.
